g.text: You describe the problem. Propel picks the mode.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #57606a

g.text: No menu, no interruption. The choice is announced in one line with its reason, and it switches again on its own

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #57606a

g.text: when the work crosses into another mode. /switch overrides it whenever you disagree.

g.text: Every mode stops at its gates and hands the decision back to you. A narrower mode runs fewer gates — it does not

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2328

g.text: lower the bar at the ones it runs, and it never decides in your place to save you a question.
